assessment_summary: The proof incorrectly applies the Master Theorem. In step 0014, it assumes that $f(m) = 10 \log m$ falls into the first case of the Master Theorem, claiming $f(m) = O(m^{-\epsilon})$ for some $\epsilon > 0$ (specifically choosing $\epsilon = 0.5$). However, $10 \log m$ grows logarithmically, so it cannot be bounded by a decreasing function like $m^{-0.5}$. Thus, it does not satisfy the condition $f(m) = O(m^{-0.5})$. The error originates here in assuming the wrong case of the Master Theorem, which leads to computing an irrelevant limit in step 0016 and reaching an incorrect final bound in 0018.
